data.long_meaning: From the Old English elements eld, meaning 'old' or 'eld', and ger, meaning 'ruler' or 'leader'. The name Eldridge likely referred to an elder or a ruler in ancient times. The name Eldridge carries the meaning “Ruler of the eld” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eldridge usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the eld and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eldridge total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
